items.headline: Fitch Upgrades Albemarle Corporation's Ratings to 'BBB'; Outlook Stable
items.snippet: Albemarle's lithium asset base includes high-grade, long-life brine and spodumene resources that support a favorable cost position... Fitch expects continued healthy lithium demand; potential industry overcapacity remains a key risk to lithium prices.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10% on stationary battery storage; Albemarle's scenarios show 2026 adj. EBITDA of $0.9-1.0B at ~$10/kg LCE vs $2.4-2.6B at ~$20/kg.

items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle strong following Mizuho upgrade
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral, keeping a $130 target; sees lithium carbonate rising from $18,375/t to $22,500/t by end of next year as supply lags demand.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho: strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance favorable; raises 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k. Albemarle is the lowest-cost lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its target to $135 from $230, keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% y/y but well below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowers lithium company targets after spot price weakness but views the group as oversold; keeps Outperform on Albemarle.
